docs-local.description: Offline documentation library search (NetApp, Dell, VMware, Cisco, Kubernetes docs, KBs and bug trackers): search_docs, read_chunk, read_document, list_sources

databases.description: Read-only PostgreSQL / MongoDB for your own apps (connections in ~/.claude/brain/databases.json)

powermax.description: Dell PowerMax live state (Unisphere): arrays, volumes, storage groups, masking views, ports, SRDF / SnapVX, alerts, performance

harvest.description: NetApp Harvest metrics: ONTAP performance and capacity history (latency, IOPS, throughput, CPU)

mds.description: Cisco MDS fabrics: zoning, device-alias, FLOGI / FCNS, ports, port-channels, errors

ucsc.description: Cisco UCS Central: service profiles, vHBAs, FI FC uplinks, faults

kuparashit.description: VMware inventory map from every vCenter: ESX hosts, pWWNs, NAAs, datastores, RDMs, VMs - the join between layers

aria.description: VMware Aria Operations: VM, host and datastore metrics and alerts
